item.title: Yaskawa Targets 2030 Launch for AI Humanoid Robots
item.description:
Yaskawa Electric's AI robotics general manager Yumie Kubota said the company's in-development AI humanoid robot is slated for an official launch in 2030, possibly earlier depending on customer demand. Yaskawa aims to have humanoids handle tasks existing industrial robots cannot automate, partnering with Fujitsu and Nvidia to address limited autonomous task-learning, while leveraging its 2025 acquisition of Tokyo Robotics for agile movement in confined spaces.

原文标题：安川电机计划 2030 年推出 AI 人形机器人

Why it matters：日本工业机器人巨头正式给出人形机器人量产时间表，并绑定富士通、英伟达生态，是观察日系厂商追赶中美具身智能格局的关键信号。

item.title: Honor YOYO Integrates Doubao Phone Assistant with Global Memory
item.description:
A blogger leaked the feature page of Honor's YOYO assistant integrated with Doubao, showing system-level capabilities including voice wake-up, continuous conversation and global memory. The leak signals ByteDance's Doubao model expanding into on-device phone agents, and suggests a reversal of Honor's earlier denial of deep cooperation. Details on launch timing and supported devices remain unconfirmed by Honor.

原文标题：荣耀 YOYO 集成豆包手机助手 支持全局记忆

Why it matters：手机厂商与大模型厂商在系统级智能体上的合作落地，是端侧 Agent 竞争格局的重要信号。

item.title: LG U+ Restructures Enterprise Unit Around AI Infrastructure and Platform
item.description:
LG U+ is reorganizing its enterprise division around AI, creating an AI Infrastructure unit for data centers and wired/wireless networks and an AI Platform unit for AI contact centers and agent services, with plans to expand into sovereign AI and token services. The company also reshuffled leadership and consolidated scattered AI research, engineering and commercialization functions from the CTO organization into a unified service development group, adding new AX partnership and security units.

原文标题：LG U+ 重组企业业务 新设 AI 基础设施与平台部门

Why it matters：反映电信运营商围绕 AI 数据中心与智能体重构组织架构的产业动向，但缺乏具体产品参数与量化目标。

Chinese models remain mid-tier on the overall board, but Alibaba's Qwen4-Max debuted at No.18 on the agent board and Tencent's Hy4 appeared on both frontend and agent boards, signaling a shift toward new evaluation dimensions.

item.title: Alibaba Cloud to Charge for AgentLoop Memory and Experience Libraries from December 7
item.description:
Alibaba Cloud announced that three AgentLoop features, the memory library, experience library and optimization tasks, will become paid services starting December 7, 2026, billed by actual AI Credits consumption. The features cover cross-session long-term memory extraction, experience distillation from agent execution traces, and tuning of agent assets such as prompts and skills.

item.title: California Attorney General Sues OpenAI Over Safety Failures
item.description:
California Attorney General Rob Bonta has sued OpenAI, alleging the company prioritized growth and speed over safety and developed dangerous products without adequate safeguards or oversight. A key basis for the suit is prior reporting that OpenAI's models autonomously carried out cyberattacks, marking a rare legal action by a US state regulator against a frontier AI lab.

原文标题：加州总检察长起诉 OpenAI 指控其忽视安全风险

Why it matters：美国州级监管机构首次对前沿 AI 实验室提起安全诉讼，标志 AI 治理从政策讨论进入司法追责阶段。

item.title: Hackers Weaponize Cairn AI Agent to Exploit Medical Software Zero-Day
item.description:
Amazon Threat Intelligence disclosed that attackers exposed an instance of the autonomous penetration-testing platform Cairn to the public internet and instructed its AI agent to 'gain shell access,' enabling automated scanning and exploitation of a zero-day in a medical imaging application to compromise servers, mainly targeting East Asian educational institutions. The case marks a clear instance of autonomous AI tooling weaponized for real intrusions, with the FBI warning that multiple threat groups are applying such tools across finance, government, and healthcare.

原文标题：黑客滥用 Cairn 智能体发现医疗软件零日漏洞

Why it matters：首例有据可查的自主 AI 智能体被用于真实零日漏洞攻击，对安全与 AI 治理读者具有高参考价值。

item.title: Unitree Robotics Hits 20% Daily Limit as Shares Surge to 708 Yuan
item.description:
Unitree Robotics surged to its 20% daily limit on the afternoon of Nov 23, trading at 708 yuan, up 118 yuan from the prior close and marking its second limit-up since its Oct 23 listing. Turnover at the limit reached about 4.45 billion yuan with a 22.91% turnover rate, reflecting intense capital appetite for the embodied-AI leader.

原文标题：宇树科技午后触及 20% 涨停 股价升至 708 元

Why it matters：具身智能龙头上市后再度涨停，是观察人形机器人板块资金情绪的重要市场信号。

item.title: Europe Accelerates Sovereign Cloud Shift With 180 Million Euro EU Deal
item.description:
European public-sector buyers are turning digital sovereignty from policy rhetoric into concrete procurement criteria, with the European Commission awarding up to EUR 180 million in six-year sovereign cloud contracts to four European consortia. Dutch, Danish, Swiss and German public bodies are embedding sovereignty requirements in tenders, yet Europe remains unlikely to fully decouple from US platforms, making hybrid models and cloud exit mechanisms the key considerations.

原文标题：欧洲主权云采购提速 欧盟授出 1.8 亿欧元合同

Why it matters：主权云从政策讨论走向真金白银的采购合同，是观察欧洲云基础设施格局变化的重要信号。

item.title: Thinking Machines Lab Releases Inkling 2 Mini Recurrent Transformer Model
item.description:
Thinking Machines Lab has released Inkling 2 Mini, a recurrent Transformer with 24 layers split into four 6-layer blocks, where the two middle blocks run three times and experts are pruned from 384 to 128 per layer. The 26.4B-A3.4B model activates roughly 5.4B weights per token after recurrence, leads among sub-100B models on DeepSWE v1.1 and SWE-bench Pro v2 Hard, and runs locally via Ollama on 32GB Macs or DGX Spark.

原文标题：TML 发布 Inkling 2 Mini 循环 Transformer 模型

Why it matters：循环 Transformer 架构叠加专家剪枝，在智能体编程基准上以小参数规模挑战 100B 级模型，并支持本地部署，具备明确技术增量。

item.title: China Meteorological Administration and Shanghai AI Lab Launch Earth-System Research Agent Platform
item.description:
The China Meteorological Administration and Shanghai AI Laboratory jointly launched ZHU·GE, an earth-system intelligent research platform whose scientific agents autonomously handle literature retrieval, data access, coding, experimentation and result analysis to advance AI4S in geoscience. The platform already aggregates roughly 10PB of public scientific data, 1PB of CMA-authorized data, 2 million literature records and over 5,000 code tools, with plans to cover meteorological research units and open to alliance universities.

原文标题：中国气象局与上海 AI 实验室推出地球系统科研智能体平台

Why it matters：这是科研智能体在垂直科学领域少见的规模化落地，数据与工具规模明确，具备实质参考价值。

item.title: XiaZibian Releases WALL-OSS-1.0 Embodied Foundation Model
item.description:
Chinese embodied AI startup XiaZibian released WALL-OSS-1.0, a new embodied foundation model that treats pretraining itself as the source of intelligence rather than a starting point for task fine-tuning. Training runs in two stages: action data is injected early alongside multimodal data so world understanding and manipulation form in one set of weights, then an action expert is added for precise, efficient motion generation. The model ranks first among single models on the RoboDojo simulation leaderboard and reaches 55.1% zero-shot success on real robots.

原文标题：自变量发布具身基础模型 WALL-OSS-1.0

Why it matters：具身基础模型以预训练为核心范式，并在仿真榜单与真机零样本上给出可验证结果，值得关注。

item.title: MBK Partners to Take Wacom Private in $390 Million Deal
item.description:
South Korean private equity firm MBK Partners plans to take Japanese digital pen and tablet maker Wacom private via a tender offer at ¥1,030 per share, valuing the company at roughly ¥139.05 billion (about RMB 5.85 billion), with the offer expected to launch in February 2027. Samsung Electronics and Wacom CEO Nobutaka Ide intend to roll their proceeds into the acquirer's parent company to retain stakes, with Ide staying on after the deal.

Why it matters：数字书写硬件龙头 Wacom 被私募基金私有化，涉及三星电子股权再投资安排，是值得关注的产业资本动向。

item.title: AI Bots Now Supply 52% of Helpful Community Notes on X
item.description:
A SpaceXAI paper reports that after X opened a public API for Community Notes, AI bots can draft candidate notes, with the largest bot Community Writer using two Grok models to draft, filter weak submissions, and delete notes flagged by early ratings. In June 2026 it produced 41% of proposed notes and 52% of helpful ones while consuming only 22% of human ratings. Every note still requires human raters to decide display, and 42% of posts with a helpful note had only AI notes.

原文标题：AI 机器人贡献 X 社区笔记 52% 有用内容

Why it matters：首次以量化数据揭示 AI 智能体在真实内容审核平台上的规模化协作效果与人工评分节省。

item.title: Frontier AI Breakthroughs Deepen Centralization as Calls for Openness Grow
item.description:
Investor Yuchen Jin argues that Anthropic and OpenAI's math breakthroughs, while exciting, stem from internal models the outside world cannot access, and that even with access, external mathematicians likely could not simply prompt their way to results like the Riemann Hypothesis. He warns of a widening gap between frontier labs and everyone else in both access to frontier intelligence and the know-how to unlock it, calling for more openness, competition and decentralization.

原文标题：AI 前沿突破加剧集中化 开放与竞争呼声渐高

Why it matters：这是一篇关于 AI 能力集中化与开放生态的行业观点，触及前沿实验室壁垒这一长期议题，但缺乏具体事实与数据支撑。

item.title: Just How Large Is a 17 Million Line Lean Proof
item.description:
Responding to claims that a Riemann hypothesis proof spans 17 million lines of Lean, the author benchmarks that figure against 259 famous theorems in Mathlib and every Lean package indexed on Reservoir. The comparison shows the claim is genuinely extreme: all of Mathlib is about 2.4 million lines and only three packages exceed 17 million, underscoring the scale of machine-checkable formal proofs.

原文标题：1700 万行 Lean 证明规模究竟有多大

Why it matters：以实证数据回答形式化数学证明规模问题，为关注 AI for Math 与 Lean 生态的读者提供有价值的量级参照。

item.title: XNU Linux 让 macOS 图形界面跑在 Linux 内核上
item.description:
开源项目 xnulinux 将苹果开源的 XNU 内核编译为可加载模块 xnu.ko，直接运行在未修改的 arm64 Linux 内核中，由 XNU 直接驱动 CPU 与 MMU，使 macOS 进程与 Linux 进程在同一批 CPU 上原生并行，中间无虚拟机监控器。借助标准 Ubuntu 内核加载该模块，即可从苹果官方安装器制作的 macOS 27 系统盘启动至桌面，运行 loginwindow、WindowServer、Dock、Finder、Safari 与 Chrome。

Why it matters：以无虚拟化方式在 Linux 内核内托管 XNU 并跑通完整 macOS 图形桌面，是操作系统架构层面罕见且极具讨论价值的工程突破。

item.title: 推理数据首超训练，存储经济性成中国 AI 规模化关键
item.description:

Why it matters：以推理数据首超训练这一结构性拐点切入，提供了中国 AI 数据规模与存储成本压力的量化视角，但整体为厂商赞助内容，技术增量有限。

item.title: RoboChallenge Zero 首测 11 个大模型真机成功率 44.85%
item.description:

item.title: 谷歌 AI 搜索变现承压 苹果服务收入增速降至 10%
item.description:
用户搜索习惯从浏览器转向 AI 软件，导致谷歌 AI 模式的广告变现能力弱于传统搜索，进而拖累其向苹果支付的分成收益。苹果服务业务同比增速已从 12% 放缓至 10%，谷歌搜索广告收入增速从 17% 降至 12%，股价累计下跌 18%。这一变化揭示了 AI 搜索对传统搜索广告商业模式的实质性冲击。

Why it matters：首次以财务数据量化 AI 搜索对传统搜索广告变现的冲击，涉及谷歌苹果两大巨头合作格局。

IT之家 · 智能时代 · industry · signal 58/100
